title: Model-version read filtering must use the prompt-aware predicate and judge the whole object
answers: prompt versions visible with a registered model wildcard grant
prompt grant does not show prompt version in search
body:
Symptom: a user with a registered-model grant (even `*`) sees prompt versions in search results, or a user with a prompt grant cannot see the prompt version they were granted.
Root cause: the earlier nested and top-level model-version filter used _role_based_read_predicate(username, "registered_model") applied to mv.name. Prompts share the same search resolver, so registered_model grants decided prompt visibility.
Fix pattern: build the predicate with _rm_or_prompt_read_predicate(username) (in GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware._model_version_read_predicate) and pass the whole model-version object to it, not its name, matching the REST filter_search_model_versions.
Constraints: any new model-version filter in the auth layer must use this predicate; a registered_model grant, including a wildcard, must not reveal prompts. Covered by test_graphql_search_model_versions_judges_prompts_by_prompt_grants in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py.
Applies: every place the basic-auth GraphQL middleware or REST search filters model-version rows.
applies: Any model-version row filter in mlflow/server/auth, including GraphQL middleware post-filters and REST search filtering.
says: Users with registered model access can see prompt versions in search results.
Search results do not show prompt versions to users who have explicit prompt permissions.
Wildcard permissions on registered models should not grant visibility into saved prompts.
Ensure prompt authorization rules decide which prompt versions appear in version searches.
search: Model-version read filtering across basic-auth GraphQL middleware and REST search endpoints must use prompt-aware authorization predicates on entire model-version objects. In mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware._model_version_read_predicate and _filter_model_versions_result call _rm_or_prompt_read_predicate to evaluate the complete object rather than checking mv.name against registered_model. Registered-model grants, including wildcards, must not expose prompt versions, while prompt grants must govern prompt visibility in search queries. Verified by test_graphql_search_model_versions_judges_prompts_by_prompt_grants in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py.
